why: Stops the mute button relabelling itself, which turns `.hud-mute--active` into a genuinely colour-only state while its allowlist entry still says the label carries it. An allowlist nobody rechecks is exactly how the per-instance pins this sweep replaces went stale, so every entry that claims a second channel is asserted against the tree: the reason has to stay true or the entry fails. Note the mutation is in hud.ts and the test is in hud.css.test.ts -- the guard deliberately reaches across, because the state is in the stylesheet and the channel that excuses it is not.
killedBy: hud.css: no state is carried by colour alone (issue #926) keeps the allowlist honest: every entry is still colour-only, and still reinforced
